title: Amazon Tops $3T, Meta Rallies 7% as AI Hyperscalers Ride Earnings Momentum
excerpt: Blowout cloud earnings and a sudden geopolitical thaw sent the biggest AI names surging Monday, but the question investors are scrambling to answer is whethe...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • Amazon crossed $3 trillion in market cap and Microsoft's Azure topped $100 billion in annual sales as both stocks surged 5% Monday.

  • Google Cloud grew 82% and Alphabet raised capex to $205B; Oracle's cloud infrastructure jumped 93% yet ORCL remains down 28% YTD.

  • Meta Platforms leads the group up 7% as advertising revenue climbed 27% to $59B, recovering the 9% drop from its mixed Q2 earnings print.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Microsoft didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Mega-cap AI names are surging in Monday midday trading as strong hyperscaler earnings and an easing geopolitical backdrop lift the entire cohort. Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) shares are up 5% to $488.16, while Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) shares climb 5% to $283.89, pushing Amazon's market capitalization past $3 trillion.

Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) shares lead the group, up 7% to $593.15, and Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares gain 5% to $374.40. Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) shares are rallying 8% to $139.80, and the Invesco QQQ Trust (NASDAQ:QQQ) is up 1.67% to $699.45.

The catalyst for MSFT, AMZN, META, GOOGL and ORCL is a mix of last week's blowout hyperscaler earnings and a risk-on market mood after President Trump called off strikes on Iran. Traders are treating Monday's session as an earnings-relief rally, with breathing room returning to a cohort that spent much of July fielding AI capex questions.

Earnings Momentum Fuels the Mega-Cap Bid

Microsoft's Q4 FY2026 report set the tone. Azure revenue grew 43% year over year (YoY), and the segment topped $100 billion in annual sales for the first time. CEO Satya Nadella stated, "This year, Azure revenue surpassed $100 billion for the first time, and Microsoft 365 Copilot reached over 30 million paid seats, reflecting the confidence customers are placing in us to power their AI transformation."

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Microsoft didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Amazon followed with AWS revenue up 37% to $42.2 billion, its fastest pace in 18 quarters. CEO Andy Jassy noted that the company's AI and chip businesses each now run at about a $25 billion annual revenue run rate. Consolidated Q2 2026 revenue reached $200.6 billion, and operating income climbed 43.2% YoY.

Meta Platforms shares have now recovered the 9% drop that followed the company's mixed Q2 print. The report missed on EPS at $6.18 against $7.2173 expected, weighed by $2.4 billion in legal charges and $1.18 billion in severance. Advertising revenue still climbed 27% to $59.4 billion, and CEO Mark Zuckerberg stated, "AI is accelerating our core business today, powering our next generation of products, and opening the door to entirely new enterprise opportunities."

由于强劲的超大规模盈利和宽松的地缘政治背景提振了整个群体，大型人工智能公司在周一午盘交易中飙升。 微软 (NASDAQ:MSFT) 股价上涨 5%，至 488.16 美元，而亚马逊 (NASDAQ:AMZN) 股价上涨 5%，至 283.89 美元，推动亚马逊市值突破 3 万亿美元。

Meta Platforms (纳斯达克股票代码：META) 股价上涨 7%，至 593.15 美元，领涨，Alphabet (纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL) 股价上涨 5%，至 374.40 美元。 甲骨文 (NYSE:ORCL) 股价上涨 8%，至 139.80 美元，Invesco QQQ Trust (NASDAQ:QQQ) 上涨 1.67%，至 699.45 美元。

MSFT、AMZN、META、GOOGL 和 ORCL 的催化剂是上周超大型企业的井喷式盈利以及特朗普总统取消对伊朗的打击后市场的风险情绪。 交易员将周一的交易视为收益缓解的反弹，7 月份大部分时间都在处理人工智能资本支出问题的群体得到了喘息的空间。

盈利势头推动巨型股竞购

微软 2026 财年第四季度报告定下了基调。 Azure 收入同比增长 43%，该细分市场的年销售额首次突破 1000 亿美元。 首席执行官 Satya Nadella 表示：“今年，Azure 收入首次突破 1000 亿美元，Microsoft 365 Copilot 付费席位超过 3000 万，反映出客户对我们推动人工智能转型的信心。”

立即行动：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而微软并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

亚马逊紧随其后，AWS 收入增长 37%，达到 422 亿美元，这是 18 个季度以来最快的增幅。 首席执行官安迪·贾西 (Andy Jassy) 指出，该公司的人工智能和芯片业务目前的年收入运行速度约为 250 亿美元。 2026 年第二季度合并收入达到 2006 亿美元，营业收入同比增长 43.2%。

Meta Platforms 股价现已收复该公司第二季度业绩好坏参半后的 9% 跌幅。 由于 24 亿美元的法律费用和 11.8 亿美元的遣散费，该报告的每股收益未达预期，为 6.18 美元，而预期为 7.2173 美元。 广告收入仍然增长 27%，达到 594 亿美元，首席执行官马克扎克伯格表示，“人工智能正在加速我们今天的核心业务，为我们的下一代产品提供动力，并为全新的企业机会打开大门。”
